people.title: People
people.noMatch: No one with that name among the loaded people.

detail.pick: Choose a person to see their voice samples.
detail.samplesHint: used only to suggest who is speaking
detail.noSamples: No voice samples yet. They are saved when you confirm who is speaking in a meeting and choose samples to remember.

revoke.title: Revoke this sample?
revoke.body: It stops being used to suggest who is speaking. The recording and its history stay.

inspector.none: No meetings with voice samples yet.
inspector.privacy: Samples stay on this computer. Revoking a sample stops using it in suggestions.

descriptions.recording: Used by the record button, by meetings and by detected calls.
descriptions.transcription: Runs on this computer, nothing is sent out.
descriptions.integrations: Optional. Nothing leaves this computer until you connect.
descriptions.shortcuts: Global shortcuts work even when the window is hidden.
descriptions.storage: Your notes are plain Markdown files in this folder.
descriptions.diagnostics: Text to paste when reporting a problem.

ambient.title: Gradient background
ambient.hint: Turn off for a plain background.

output.title: Computer audio
output.hint: What the others say on the call.

devices.error: Could not list the audio devices.
devices.liveNote: The current recording keeps the devices it started with; a change applies to the next one.

detection.title: Notify when a call starts
detection.hint: Teams, Meet, Zoom. Linux with PipeWire or PulseAudio.

transcription.perMeeting: Each meeting chooses its models in its Transcription tab.
transcription.noDefault: No default model in the app config.

autoRecord.title: Record calls automatically
autoRecord.hint: Starts recording when a call is detected, even with the window closed. Tell participants: you are responsible for the recording. Coxinha shows REC and a notification for every recording.
autoRecord.stopHint: Any recording made during a call stops a minute after the call ends, once nobody speaks into the microphone. The strip shows the countdown so you can keep recording.
autoRecord.needsDetection: Turning on automatic recording also turns on call detection.

live.title: Transcribe during the call
live.hint: Uses Tagarela on this computer while recording. The text is provisional and nothing leaves the machine.
live.needsModel: No model found on this computer. Download the public Parakeet v3 (740 MB, CC-BY-4.0) or choose a file below.
live.modelHint: Parakeet pt-BR .gguf file. Read-only: Coxinha never changes Handy's file.
live.threadsHint: Fewer threads leave more CPU for the call and for Handy.
live.backlogHint: While nothing is recording, transcribes meetings without a complete transcript on its own, newest first, and then separates who spoke. A call or processing goes first.

titles.title: Suggested title
titles.hint: Titles automatic recordings without a calendar event, using your own server over SSH.
titles.privacy: Sends only transcript text excerpts, never audio.
titles.summariesPrivacy: After each transcript, sends the whole transcript text, in parts, to this same server to write a summary with decisions and actions. Off by default; never audio.

palette.title: Command palette
palette.placeholder: Search notes or run an action

import.title: Import people from your calendar
import.description: Everyone invited to the meetings in your calendar who is not in People yet. Only the name is saved.
import.noCalendar: Connect Outlook in Settings to import the participants of your meetings.
import.empty: Everyone in your calendar is already in People.
import.consent: Participant in meetings from your calendar
